notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites:
The Trickster-God's Heist has one lore counter on it.
An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
At the beginning of your first main phase, put a lore counter on The Trickster God's Heist, causing its second chapter ability to trigger.
Resolve the chapter ability, exchanging control of a nonbasic, noncreature permanent an opponent controls and Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
